name: @org/ds
description: Framework-independent design token foundation. Layer 1 compiles away, layer 2 is the public contract, adapters are leaves.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run lint
scripts.build:example-itau: sass --no-source-map --load-path=. example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/ds.scss example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/ds.css && tailwindcss -i example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/entry.css -o example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/tw.css
scripts.build:tokens: sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/ds.scss dist/ds.css && npm run build:demo-themes && node scripts/check-collisions.mjs dist/ds.css && node scripts/check-dangling-refs.mjs dist/ds.css dist/demo-themes.css && node scripts/check-state-families.mjs dist/ds.css && node scripts/check-layer3-bypass.mjs src/adapters && node scripts/check-token-grammar.mjs src/_component.scss && node scripts/check-custom-prop-interpolation.mjs src example && node scripts/check-theme-proof.mjs example --skip=bootstrap-5.3.8-examples && node scripts/check-adapter-forms.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:demo-themes && npm run build:adapters && npm run build:bootstrap && npm run build:daisyui && npm run build:pico && npm run build:bulma && npm run build:tailwind && npm run build:flowbite && npm run build:preline && npm run build:water && npm run build:mvp && npm run build:nescss && npm run build:coreui && npm run build:themes && npm run export:tokens
scripts.demo:examples: npm run build:bootstrap && npm run build:daisyui && npm run build:example-hot-tone && npm run build:example-cyberpunk && npm run build:example-carmageddon && npm run build:example-caderninho && npm run docs:carmageddon && npm run docs:caderninho && npm run build:example-itau && npm run build:example-booking && npm run build:example-caderno && npm run build:example-recepta && npm run docs:foundations
scripts.verify: npm run build:tokens && npm run lint && npm run verify:examples && npm run verify:utilities && npm run verify:examples-refs && npm run verify:forms && npm run verify:chain && npm run audit:contrast
scripts.verify:examples: node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/ds-hot-tone-bootstrap-phase1 --ledger example/ds-hot-tone-bootstrap-phase1/patterns.json && node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/ds-cyberpunk-bulma-phase2 --ledger example/ds-cyberpunk-bulma-phase2/patterns.json && node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/ds-carmageddon-nescss-phase3 --ledger example/ds-carmageddon-nescss-phase3/patterns.json && node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/ds-meu-caderninho-daisyui-phase3 --ledger example/ds-meu-caderninho-daisyui-phase3/patterns.json && node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3 --ledger example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/patterns.json && node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/ds-booking-bulma --ledger example/ds-booking-bulma/patterns.json && node scripts/verify-patterns.mjs example/recepta-monochrome-coreui --ledger example/recepta-monochrome-coreui/patterns.json
scripts.verify:utilities: node scripts/check-utilities.mjs example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/index.html example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/tw.css example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/ds.css example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/app.css
scripts.verify:examples-refs: node scripts/check-dangling-refs.mjs example/ds-booking-bulma/ds.css example/ds-caderno-accent-driven/ds.css example/ds-caderno-accent-driven/app.css example/ds-carmageddon-nescss-phase3/ds.css example/ds-cyberpunk-bulma-phase2/ds.css example/ds-hot-tone-bootstrap-phase1/ds.css example/ds-hot-tone-bootstrap-phase1/app.css example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/ds.css example/ds-itau-shadcn-phase3/app.css example/ds-meu-caderninho-daisyui-phase3/ds.css example/ds-meu-caderninho-daisyui-phase3/app.css example/recepta-monochrome-coreui/ds.css example/recepta-monochrome-coreui/app.css
